name: mectracker
description: Lets Claude drive the Mec Tracker panel in Premiere Pro (track masks, paste keyframes) without screenshots or clicks.
long_description: Mec Tracker reads the motion of a mask in Premiere Pro and pastes it as Transform keyframes on other clips (follow) or on the same clip (stabilize). This connector gives Claude short commands for the panel: status, list clips, set options, track, paste, wait, cancel, discard and log. In Premiere, open the Mec Tracker panel (3.4.0 or newer), go to Help and tick "Allow Claude to control the panel". Everything stays on your computer (127.0.0.1).

tools.name: mectracker_status
tools.description: Panel state: sequence, playhead, selection, options, tracks, current job.

tools.name: mectracker_list_clips
tools.description: Video clips of the active sequence with ids.

tools.name: mectracker_set_options
tools.description: Follow/Stabilize, Position/Rotation/Scale, keyframe interval, Paste Straight to Clip Above.

tools.name: mectracker_track
tools.description: Track the mask of the given or selected clip(s).

tools.name: mectracker_paste
tools.description: Paste the stored track(s) onto target clips.

tools.name: mectracker_log
tools.description: Last lines of the panel log.
